name: Survey tile in Sagittarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Sagittarius, imaged by SPHEREx 22 times in 9 visits over 83 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 44 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.5 days starting 2026-04-20, at wavelengths from 0.87 to 5.00 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
